newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - April 24.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Bangladesh Newspapers - April 24.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bangladesh press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
The Bank Reforms Committee has recommended that no loan defaulter or his family members should be allowed to become directors of any private bank.
The percentage of landless people in Bangladesh has increased from 30 to 60 percent in the last 22 years, said Law Minister Abdul Matin Khasru on Wednesday.
The local knitwear industry is facing a severe crisis following a drastic fall in orders from the European Union member states consequent upon the withdrawal of GSP facilities for the product.
An international gang of smugglers is poaching elephant in deep forests in Bangladesh.
Nor'wester accompanied by hailstorm lashed different parts of Dhaka and nearby Manikganj districts on Wednesday, killing two people and injuring at least 50 others.
Unknown assailants shot dead a leader of the ruling Awami League's student front in Tangail district on Wednesday.

Bangladesh is set to register real GDP growth of 5.4 percent in 1997 and six in 1998 as against 4.4 and 4.7 percent achieved in 1995 and 1995 respectively, a country projection report of the Asian Development Bank (ADB) said.
A lubricant oil blending plant with an annual capacity of about 12,000 tonnes will go into production in Chittagong by December. REUTER
